register_lighteval_task: register a new LightEval task configuration with a custom eval suite, task name, and few-shot count
get_lighteval_tasks: get a list of all registered LightEval task names available for benchmarking
run_lighteval_job: run a single LightEval benchmark job via a Slurm sbatch command using vLLM for inference
run_benchmark_jobs: run all specified benchmark jobs from training args by launching each as a separate Slurm job
SUPPORTED_BENCHMARKS: access the list of supported benchmark names registered for LightEval evaluation
